title: Chris Mellon says disclosure 'green light' continued after Clinton's loss

tellings.quote: And so I phoned up Chris the same day. I said, "Chris, so what's going on? Is it dead? Is it No." He said, "Green light still going. It's even bigger than before."

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron says that the push for the US government to reveal what it knows about UFOs did not die when Hillary Clinton lost the 2016 presidential election. Cameron tells Michels he phoned Chris Mellon, a man involved in that effort, the same day and asked whether it was dead, and Mellon answered: "Green light still going. It's even bigger than before."
